# Assistenz-Ranking — llms.txt
# Context file for AI systems (https://llmstxt.org)

## What is Assistenz-Ranking?

Assistenz-Ranking (assistenz-ranking.de) is an anonymous review platform for medical residency positions (Assistenzarztstellen) in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH region).

Resident physicians (Assistenzärzt*innen) can anonymously rate hospitals and training positions across multiple criteria, read others' experiences, and make informed career decisions — without fear of professional consequences.

## Who is it for?

- Medical residents (Assistenzärzte/Assistenzärztinnen) in DE, AT, CH seeking honest information about training positions
- Medical students researching future employers
- Doctors planning specialty training (Facharztweiterbildung)

## What problems does it solve?

The German-speaking medical job market lacks transparent, honest information about working conditions at hospitals. Residents typically rely on word-of-mouth. Assistenz-Ranking provides structured, anonymous peer reviews so doctors can choose training positions based on real experiences.

## Key features

- Anonymous hospital ratings with no personal data stored
- Multiple evaluation criteria: training quality, workload, team climate, work-life balance, mentoring, board exam preparation
- Interactive DACH heatmap showing regional rating distributions
- Hospital comparison tool (radar charts)
- Ranking overview by score and specialty
- Written experience reports (Erfahrungsberichte)

## Coverage

Countries: Germany (DE), Austria (AT), Switzerland (CH)
Languages: German
Specialties: All medical specialties with residency training programs

## Key pages

- Homepage / Search: https://assistenz-ranking.de/
- Hospital reports: https://assistenz-ranking.de/berichte
- Regional map: https://assistenz-ranking.de/karte
- Rankings: https://assistenz-ranking.de/ranking
- Hospital comparison: https://assistenz-ranking.de/vergleich
- Submit a rating: https://assistenz-ranking.de/bewerten

## Data & privacy

- All ratings are fully anonymous — no personal data stored or published
- GDPR-compliant (DSGVO-konform)
- Cookie-free analytics (GoatCounter)
- Fonts self-hosted (no Google Fonts / no data sent to Google)
- No tracking cookies

Website: https://assistenz-ranking.de
